notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow neighbours!



It has been a week since the end of Steam Next Fest Summer 2025! However we're keeping our demo up on steam so please feel free the share the game! (Every wishlist counts, and is appreciated fully~)



We're ramping up our promotions and we're excited to announce that Love In Tiny Spaces is releasing on 31st July 2025! It's coming really soon!


[previewyoutube="gNL1PQbtmiI;full"][/previewyoutube]
We're working hard on finishing the game and we hope you enjoy our little tiny game soon~



If you're content creator making content or streaming our game, feel free to tag us at our socials:

Twitter Bluesky Instagram Tiktok Youtube



With Love,
